description: For every coherent family, its constructed Aronszajn tree has a unique root, and each node has an extension at every larger domain below omega one.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajnTree_root_and_extensions
  (s : (a : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.OmegaOne) → ↑(Set.Iio a) → ℕ)
  (hs : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsCoherentFamily s) :
  (∃! r, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajnTree s hs) r = 0) ∧
    ∀ (t : (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajnTree s hs).carrier)
      (b : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.OmegaOne), (↑t).fst < b → ∃ u, t ≤ u ∧ (↑u).fst = b
